results.title: Independent releases and contributor handoff
results.summary: Implemented the independent release foundation and contributor handoff materials, including Release Please config, CI/release workflows, publication/release validation scripts, tests, and documentation. All declared validation commands pass. — Cycle 2 blocking findings appear addressed: exact-tag recovery now verifies the tag ref and event SHA, and post-1.0 feat/breaking Release Please cases were added. The remaining issue is non-blocking test fidelity around the bootstrap Release Please fixture. The implementation is ready to commit after considering that test improvement.
findings: medium/testing tests/release/manifest.test.ts:129 — Bootstrap coverage does not mirror the real package state: the fixture uses packageVersion 0.0.0 while packages/services/package.json is already 0.1.0, so it does not prove the spec-required empty-manifest/initial-version behavior for the actual repository setup → Add or adjust an upstream Manifest fixture that uses the real initial package version and asserts the first 0.1.0 release is still produced
